title: erysimum capitatum subsp. lompocense
intro: Erysimum capitatum subsp. lompocense, commonly known as Lompoc wallflower, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is known to exhibit various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of Lompoc wallflower include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential applications of this plant in traditional medicine.
